$comment: Distribution channel matrix — tracks every release channel, its artifact, status, and blocking decisions.

channels.targetAudience: Power users, first-time users following README
channels.checksumSource: checksums.txt and librespot-release-manifest.json from the GitHub release

channels.targetAudience: Users who prefer a native desktop shell over the script UI
channels.checksumSource: checksums.txt and librespot-release-manifest.json from the GitHub release
blockingDecisions: Finalize executable name (LibreSpot.exe vs LibreSpot-Desktop.exe) — depends on rebrand decision
Document checksum-first SmartScreen guidance for the preview artifact

channels.targetAudience: Admins using Intune, PDQ, SCCM, WinRM, or PSRemoting
channels.checksumSource: checksums.txt and librespot-release-manifest.json from the GitHub release
channels.requiredCliSwitches: --version; status --json; detect --json; detect --intune; validate --answer-file; plan --json; install/reapply/repair --answer-file --yes; undo --operation-id --yes; watcher install/remove --yes; uninstall --purge --yes; export-support --output

channels.targetAudience: Advanced users who follow the verified PowerShell script path in README
channels.artifact: LibreSpot.ps1 (downloaded, hash-checked against checksums.txt, then run from a local path)
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; checksum bootstrap is the verified path)

channels.targetAudience: Windows users who prefer winget install/upgrade
channels.artifact: pending — PS2EXE .exe or .NET self-contained or zip
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; winget InstallerSha256 remains required)
blockingDecisions: Finalize package identity (publisher name, package ID)
Choose artifact: PS2EXE exe vs .NET exe vs installer

channels.targetAudience: Developers and power users who prefer Scoop buckets
channels.packageId: pending — librespot in a custom bucket
channels.artifact: pending — portable zip or single exe
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; Scoop SHA256 verification remains required)
channels.checksumSource: Scoop manifest hash field from GitHub release asset
blockingDecisions: Decide own bucket vs community bucket submission

channels.targetAudience: Enterprise/IT users who prefer Chocolatey packages
channels.artifact: pending — nupkg wrapping GitHub release asset
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; upstream SHA256 and package verification remain required)

channels.targetAudience: WPF desktop users who want auto-update
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; release hashes and updater verification remain required)
blockingDecisions: Update server hosting decision (GitHub Releases vs S3/R2)

channels.artifact: LibreSpot.ps1 (published as a script, not module)
channels.signingRequirement: none (unsigned by design; PSGallery account + NuGet API key required for publication)
blockingDecisions: Script metadata (.ps1 requires specific comment-based help headers)
